# Run tests

What to run: $ARGUMENTS (if empty: the full automated suite).

## 1. Choose the command

Use the commands in `CLAUDE.md` and the rules in `.claude/rules/testing/`. For test case IDs, find the tests
tagged or named with them. For `changed`, find the tests related to the files changed since the base branch
(`git diff --name-only <base>...HEAD`). If the run will take a long time or needs a deployed environment,
say so and confirm with the user first.

## 2. Run

Use the `test-runner` agent so only the summary comes back.

## 3. Classify failures

For each failure, use the `bug-triager` agent (several failures can go in one request) to decide: product bug ·
test problem · environment or data · flaky. Don't change any code in this command.

## 4. Record

- Write `docs/sdlc/testing/test-runs/YYYY-MM-DD-<suite>.md`: command, environment and version (commit),
  totals, each failure with its class and evidence, and suggested next steps. Add it to the index in
  `docs/sdlc/testing/test-runs/README.md`.
- Update "Last result" and "Date" in `docs/sdlc/testing/traceability-matrix.md` for tests linked to test cases.

## 5. Report

Totals · failures grouped by class · product bugs to raise (offer `/bug-report` with the evidence) · test
problems to fix · flaky tests · whether the exit criteria in the test strategy are met.
